admitted_variant.review: Root inspected compact-tree path/touch and exact-LRU rank/fill semantics plus independent recursive-tree/list/timestamp oracles; existing lookup/flush stimuli retained. V2 PLRU-specific assertions explicitly adapted.

times.unit: RTL simulation clock steps from t0

overlap.interpretation: descriptive interval intersection, not recoverable or saved time

translation.count_semantics: Physical normal lookup checks and N probes are separate from unique accepted logical requests. N probe miss is not accepted request miss. Unique PTW sequence is a walk.

flag_semantics: occupied AW ID mapped to another selection

ds_r_channel.note: Per-ID state intervals can overlap; do not sum different IDs/channels into wall time.

ptw_r_channel.note: Per-ID state intervals can overlap; do not sum different IDs/channels into wall time.

ddr_model.semantics: FIFO model truth, each request pays startup31 only at head. This information is observer-only, not a DUT control interface. Queued interval excludes the acceptance edge; state intervals are clipped at RLAST+1/head transition.
